table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	username=username,
	invcount=sum(counter),
	SRCount=sum(srcounter),
	salevalue=sum(saleinvvalue),
	yu=sum(yu),
	discount=sum(discount),
	miscandtax=sum(misccharges) + sum(SaleTax),
	grosssale=sum(grosssale),
	salereturn=max(salereturn),
	share = SUM(Commission),
	cgs = sum(cgs)
FROM 
	(SELECT 
		UserName = users.username,  
		InvCount=  SL.serviceinvcode,
		SRCount = 0,
		counter=1,
		srcounter=0,
		SaleInvValue =
			Round(Sum(SD.qty * (SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.discperc * 0.01)) - flatdisc + misccharges, 0)
						+
						Round(
						Sum((SD.qty * (SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01*SD.servicegstPerc ) 
						+
						Sum(SD.qty * SD.serviceflattax ) 
						+
						Round((Sum(SD.qty * (SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.discperc * 0.01)) - SL.flatdisc )*0.01*SL.serviceinvgstperc,2)
						,0),
		yu=Round(Sum(SD.qty * (SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.discperc * 0.01)) - SL.flatdisc + SL.misccharges, 0),
		
		discount= isnull(sum(SD.qty * SD.ServiceFlatDisc)
 		 		 + sum(Round( (SD.qty  * ( SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)) * SD.discperc * 0.01,2))
				 + Round(sum(Round( (SD.qty  * ( SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01),2)) * SL.discperc * 0.01,2)
				 + SL.flatdisc,0),

		misccharges=SL.misccharges,

		grosssale=isnull(sum(SD.qty * SD.price),0),

		SaleTax=Round(
			SUM( (SD.qty) * SD.ServiceFlatTax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (SD.qty * (SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.servicegstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((SD.qty * 
				(SD.price - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
				SL.flatdisc) * (SL.serviceinvgstperc * .01), 2), 0),

		salereturn=000000000.00,
		commission = isnull(sum(SD.qty * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.discperc * 0.01) * (SD.commission - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)),0),
		cgs = SUM( (SD.qty) * SD.CostPrice)
	FROM  
		serviceheader SL, ServiceDetail SD, Users	
	WHERE  
		SL.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and   
		SL.serviceinvcode = SD.serviceinvcode and	
		SL.salesmancode = Users.usercode	
	Group by 
		users.username,
		SL.serviceinvcode ,
		SL.flatdisc ,
		SL.discperc,
		SL.misccharges,
		SL.serviceinvgstperc
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		UserName = users.username,  
		InvCount=  0,
		SRCount = COUNT(T.ServiceRinvcode),
		counter=0,
		srcounter=SUM(T.SRCount),
		SaleInvValue =0,
		yu=0,
		discount= 0,
		misccharges=0,
		grosssale=0,
		SaleTax=0,
		salereturn=SUM(T.Srinvvalue),
		commission = SUM(T.Commission),
		cgs = SUM(T.CGS)
	FROM
		Users,
		(select 
			salesmancode=SL.salesmancode,
			SRCount=1,
			SL.serviceRinvcode,
			commission = - isnull(sum(SD.qty * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.discperc * 0.01) * (SD.commission - SD.ServiceFlatDisc)),0),
			cgs = - SUM((SD.qty ) * SD.CostPrice),
			Srinvvalue=
				Round(Sum(SD.qty * (SD.serviceprice - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.discperc * 0.01)) - flatdisc + misccharges, 0) +
						Round(
						ISNULL(Sum((SD.qty * (SD.serviceprice - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * SD.servicegstPerc), 0) +
						ISNULL(Sum(SD.qty * SD.serviceflattax), 0) +
						ISNULL(Round((Sum(SD.qty * (SD.serviceprice - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.discperc * 0.01)) - flatdisc ) * 0.01 * SL.serviceinvgstperc, 2),0)
						,0)
		from serviceRHeader SL, serviceRDetail SD
		where SL.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and  :ad_EndDate and  
			SL.serviceRinvcode=SD.serviceRinvcode
		group by 
			SL.salesmancode,
			SL.servicerinvcode,
			SL.discperc,
			SL.misccharges,
			SL.flatdisc,
			SL.serviceinvgstperc) T
	WHERE 
		T.salesmancode = users.usercode
	GROUP BY
		users.username) AS MAIN
Group by 
	MAIN.username
ORDER BY 
	MAIN.username
